tools.name: render
tools.description: Render this workspace's starting facts — project layout, the project's own instruction files, environment and git state — into a file, and answer where it is. Call it before `session new` and pass the path to `--prompt`; nothing here opens or steps a session.

driver.description: The program that is about to open this session, as a person would name it on a command line. Whoever calls `render` is that program, so it is the only thing that knows. Left out = ground writes nothing about it; it never guesses.

driver_help.description: A command line that prints what that program's own settings file takes. A driver is not an extension and contributes no skill, so this is how a session learns that the thing driving it is configurable at all.
